text:
tara: Quick sync — need to finalize webinar topic + rehearsal windows. Proposed topic: 'Practical inference economics — balancing latency, cost, and quality'. Draft abstract below. Confirm speakers, dry-run times, and who owns lead routing. Run-of-show snippet at bottom.

mikael: I can do the runtime deep-dive. Planning to show a tiny live batching demo + before/after numbers for latency and cost. Need 3 slides + a terminal demo.

sophia: Sounds good. Suggest we explicitly call out Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private in the abstract so customers know it's comparative. Proposed format: 20m talk (product + runtime), 10m demo, 10m customer panel, 20m Q&A.

jaz: I'll tell the customer story — happy to spotlight latency improvements and ops overhead reduction. 5–7 min is ideal. Can we get guidance on which metrics to highlight?

devrel: I'll assemble the slide template and speaker one-pagers. Draft deck link: https://drive.mock/redwood/webinar-deck (placeholder). Two dry-runs I propose: Fri 11:00 PT (full run) and Tue 09:00 PT (tech check). Mic/room check 30m before full run.

ops-bot: Calendar booked: Greenroom A reserved Fri 10:30-12:00 PT for rehearsals — attendees: tara, mikael, sophia, jaz, devrel.

tara: Thanks — @matt will you own lead routing? We want registrant segmentation wired into HubSpot with tags for: benchmarking, cost, private-deploy interest. Also post-event: route hot leads (requests for POC) to Sales SDR queue.

matt: I can own routing. I'll add three form fields: primary pain (latency/cost/privacy), company size, current deployment model. Then we'll map tags to lists and create automation: 
``
if tag contains 'POC' -> assign to SDR queue
if tag contains 'benchmark' -> send benchmark whitepaper follow-up
if tag contains 'private' -> route to enterprise AE
```

sophia: Perfect. Also let's make sure we have the benchmark narrative callouts: unit cost per token before/after batching, tail-latency percentiles, and a quick plot comparing quantized variants. Those will drive the webinar CTA.

mikael: For the live demo I need a stable toy workload and a precomputed KV cache to avoid flakiness. Ops: can we pin a small dedicated host for demo minutes?

devrel: Noted. I'll add a 'demo checklist' slide to the deck with host, test account creds, and fallback clip in case live demo flaps.

tara: Final action items: tara -> finalize abstract and send to speakers by EOD; devrel -> deck + rehearsal invites; mikael -> demo artifact + pinned host request; matt -> hubspot form mapping; sophia -> benchmark plots. Rehearsal windows: Fri 11:00 PT (full run) and Tue 09:00 PT (tech check). Please confirm :white_check_mark:.

---
Run-of-show snippet (to paste into deck):
```
00:00 Host intro (tara) — 5m
05:00 Practical inference economics (mikael + sophia) — 20m
25:00 Live demo (sophia) — 10m
35:00 Customer story (jaz) — 7m
42:00 Panel + live Q&A (all) — 18m
60:00 Close + CTA — 2m
```

Lead routing mapping (quick):
```
form fields: role, primary_pain, deployment_model
map: primary_pain=POC -> SDR; deployment_model=private -> AE; primary_pain=benchmark -> send whitepaper followup
```

tara: Any objections? If no replies by EOD I'll lock this plan and send speaker invites.
